howItWorks.title: Four steps, no surprises
howItWorks.subtitle: From a link you found while scrolling to a parcel at your door.

paste.title: Paste the link
paste.body: Any Turkish online store. We recognise the shop automatically — there is no list to pick from.

price.title: See the real price
price.body: Product, service fee, air freight and packaging, itemised in dollars. Nothing is added afterwards.

confirm.title: Confirm delivery
confirm.body: Give us your name, mobile and address. No card, no deposit, no online payment.

receive.title: Pay on delivery
receive.body: We buy it, fly it in, and a driver brings it to you. You hand over the cash then.

pricing.title: One price. Everything in it.
pricing.subtitle: You see a single delivered figure before you commit, and that is the figure you hand over.

allIn.title: One all-in price
allIn.body: Product, sourcing, air freight and packaging arrive as a single number in dollars. There is no line you have to add up.

fixed.title: Fixed at quote time
fixed.body: Your price is locked the moment you see it. Currency moves between your quote and your delivery are our problem, not yours.

noSurprises.title: Nothing added later
noSurprises.body: No customs surcharge at the door, no handling fee, no rounding up. The driver collects exactly what you were quoted.

cod.title: Paid in cash, on delivery
cod.body: Nothing leaves your pocket until the parcel is in your hands. No card, no deposit, no online payment at any point.

items.q: Which Turkish stores can I order from?
items.a: Any of them. Paste a link from any Turkish online store and ManyShops recognises the shop from the link itself. There is no approved-store list and no store you have to pick from a menu.

items.q: What is included in the price I see?
items.a: Everything: the product, buying it on your behalf in Turkey, air freight to Lebanon, and protective packaging. The figure on your quote is the figure you pay the driver — there is nothing to add on top.

items.q: Do I pay shipping or customs separately?
items.a: No. Shipping is already inside the price you are shown, and there is no customs surcharge, handling fee or delivery charge collected at the door.
No. There is no card, no deposit and no online payment anywhere in this service. You pay the full amount in cash when the parcel is handed to you in Lebanon.

items.q: Can the price change after I order?
items.a: Your price is fixed when you see it and does not move with the exchange rate. The only thing that can change it is the store itself changing its listed price before we complete the purchase, and if that happens we contact you with the new figure before spending anything.

items.q: What if the store is running a discount?
items.a: We quote you on the discounted price the store is actually charging, not the crossed-out one. If a listing is on sale, your quote shows what you save.

items.q: Where in Lebanon do you deliver?
items.a: All eight governorates: Beirut, Mount Lebanon, North, Akkar, Bekaa, Baalbek-Hermel, South and Nabatieh.
We confirm your order with you first, then buy the item in Turkey and fly it to Lebanon before a driver brings it to your address. We give you a timing estimate when we confirm.
